_comment: Paths (relative to the scaffolded shop root) to delete when --punchout=no (the default). The boilerplate ships OCI + cXML PunchOut on top of magic-token login: the /api/punchout/* route handlers, the server glue (lib/punchout.ts) and the cart transfer button. A shop that isn't a B2B e-procurement catalogue has no use for any of it. The @propeller-commerce/propeller-v2-punchout package is dropped by overlay-no-punchout/package.patch.json; the files that merely reference punchout (cart page, data/config.ts, env) are patched, not deleted.
